brand_identity.name: The Pull Theory
brand_identity.tagline: India's Premier Destination for Authentic TCG & Collectibles
brand_identity.positioning: Serious specialist TCG retailer for Pokémon, One Piece, Japanese/English/Korean sealed booster boxes, high-value singles, and card protection accessories. Premium, authentic, transparent, collector-focused.

logo_wordmark_treatment.style: High-contrast technical serif + geometric mono tag
logo_wordmark_treatment.typography: Syne / Cormorant Garamond for main wordmark (Bold, Uppercase, tracking-[0.18em]), paired with JetBrains Mono for sub-line 'TCG SPECIALIST // EST. 2026'
logo_wordmark_treatment.visual_icon: Holographic prismatic foil diamond grid mark representing the thrill of 'the pull' (sealed pack foil flash)
logo_wordmark_treatment.badge_variant: Embossed Obsidian obsidian badge with 1px Electric Amber / Foil Violet border and metallic sheen

scale.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-none
scale.eyebrow_mono: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-amber-400 font-semibold

visual_enhancers.foil_shimmer_effect: 1px hover border glow with linear-gradient background shift, dynamic subtle tilted 3D shadow
visual_enhancers.card_frame_style: 1px solid #1E293B with rounded-xl backdrop-blur-md bg-[#11151C]/90 hover:border-amber-500/50 transition-all duration-300 shadow-[0_10px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)]
visual_enhancers.region_badges: Pill containers with low-opacity backdrop (e.g. `bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30 font-mono text-xs px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full`)
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism_nav: fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#090B0E]/85 border-b border-slate-800/80

layout_and_grid.hero_section: Split asymmetric grid (col-span-12 lg:col-span-7 text & brand statement + col-span-12 lg:col-span-5 interactive featured card pull showcase)
layout_and_grid.category_grid: Tetris Bento grid layout with asymmetrical feature cards for Pokémon, One Piece, Sealed Booster Boxes, Japanese Singles, Accessories, Pre-orders
layout_and_grid.product_carousel: Horizontal overflow-x-auto snap-x snap-mandatory flex gap-6 pb-4 scrollbar-thin scrollbar-thumb-slate-800
layout_and_grid.trust_section: 3-column grid highlighting Authenticity Guarantee, Vault-Grade Shipping in India, and Direct Sourcing from Japan/USA

key_components.name: HeaderNav
key_components.description: Sticky top bar with announcement banner ('100% Guaranteed Sealed Products | Free Express Shipping Across India over ₹2,999'), logo treatment, category quick links, language dropdown, live search input with keyboard shortcut tooltip, and cart drawer button with counter badge.

key_components.name: HeroSection
key_components.description: High-impact brand positioning statement, dynamic 'Holo Foil Pulling' visual card preview card with flip/shimmer micro-interaction, quick stat counters (50,000+ Packs Opened, 100% Authentic Guarantee, 4.9/5 Collector Rating), and dual CTAs ('Explore Sealed Stock' & 'View Pre-Orders').

key_components.name: CategoryBento
key_components.description: Interactive grid highlighting categories (Pokémon TCG, One Piece TCG, Japanese Booster Boxes, Rare Singles, Protection & Sleeves, Upcoming Pre-orders) with custom count chips and high-res imagery.

key_components.name: ProductGrid
key_components.description: Featured products & New Arrivals card matrix with language pill badges (JP/EN/KR), stock state badges ('In Stock', 'Pre-Order', 'Low Stock'), rarity indicators, INR price formatting (₹), and instant 'Add to Cart' slide button.

key_components.name: LanguageRegionFilter
key_components.description: Filter tab selector for Japanese (Direct Import), English (US/EU Print), and Korean TCG editions with explanatory tooltips regarding set print quality and pull rates.

key_components.name: PreOrderHighlights
key_components.description: Dedicated release radar section with countdown timer for major upcoming set drops (e.g., Pokémon SV8a Terastal Festival, One Piece OP-09) with reserve lock CTA.

key_components.name: WhyUsTrustSection
key_components.description: Collector-oriented trust matrix: Anti-tamper bubble wrap guarantee, video proof of packing, verified serial check, and instant India-wide courier dispatch.

key_components.name: NewsletterFooter
key_components.description: VIP Collector Club newsletter signup with perk callouts (Early Access to Japanese Booster Drops), payment method icons (UPI, Cards, NetBanking), and comprehensive navigation links.

testing_and_attributes.required_data_testid_rules: All buttons, navigation tabs, filter buttons, search input, card items, cart drawer triggers, and price indicators MUST carry kebab-case role-based data-testid attributes.

javascript_file_convention.file_extension: All React frontend component files MUST use .js or .jsx extensions (not .tsx).

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the Dark Obsidian & Holo Prismatic luxury aesthetic throughout the React application.
Ensure header/navigation bar is NEVER transparent over content; always use backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#090B0E]/90 with border-b border-slate-800.
Provide clear data-testid on every interactive element.
Format currency prices in Indian Rupees (₹) with realistic TCG collector pricing.
Make sure all components are written in .js / .jsx file format.
Implement Sonner toast notifications for cart additions and wishlist interactions.
